ModMetaData.name: Project Momo Slime Faction
ModMetaData.author: Gapho
ModMetaData.description:
Adds wild slimes for Project Momo: amorphous slime-folk who wander the warm, wet grasslands.
Slimes only appear in the wild, wandering onto your map like wild men - and like wild men, they can be tamed or captured and convinced to join. They spawn from four slime xenotypes (Biotech): common blue slimes, fierce red slimes, dark slimes, and toxin-eating bubble slimes.
A small C# assembly gives the slimes their signature physiology: their hair always matches their skin, they can never be tattooed, they shed slime filth wherever they walk, and with no bones and no skin, every wound they suffer is a bruise. Butcher one and you get slime jelly, never skin. Slime jelly nourishes like insect jelly with no poison chance - but women who eat too much of it will find themselves melting into slimes. Living slimes also shed blobs of slime jelly periodically.
Their bodies are as soft as a human's to the weather: any temperature fatal to a naked human is fatal to a slime.
Requires the Biotech and Odyssey expansions, and Harmony.
